verdict.rationale: A dedicated first-party Rate Limits page covers every element of the story. It lists per-model requests-per-second and tokens-per-minute caps at each tier (T0–T4), the spend-based tier thresholds ($0/$50/$250/$1,000/$5,000), the 429 Too Many Requests semantics, and per-team limits viewable in the Console; the Batch API additionally documents higher rate limits. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the documented limits, and details on 429 response headers or retry guidance.
